text: The Coppa Italia Serie C (Italian: Serie C Italian Cup), previously known as Coppa Italia Lega Pro, is a straight knockout competition featuring teams from Serie C in Italian football, first held in 1972. The tournament consists of six rounds and starts in August with the first set, involving 56 of the 60 participating teams. The remaining four teams, which also compete in the Coppa Italia, join the competition during the second set. All matches are played as single legs, except for the semi-finals and the final. In the event of a tie—whether after a single leg or on aggregate—extra time is played, and if necessary, a penalty shootout determines the winner. In addition to receiving the trophy, the winning team qualifies for the next edition of the Coppa Italia and for the third round of Serie C promotion play-offs. If the winning team's spot is not available, it is awarded to the runners-up, or, as a secondary option, to the 4th-placed team in the same group as the winners.
